mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id as conversationId, session_uuid as sessionUuid, user_id as userId, question, MIN(create_time) AS createTime FROM ai_history_message where user_id = #{vo.userId} GROUP BY session_uuid order by create_time

SELECT id, user_id, user_name, conversation_id, agent_id, agent_name, fenci_session_id, fenci_agent_id, fenci_agent_name, question, actual_question, split_words, answer, answer_all, permission, is_deep, is_good, answer_time,session_uuid, question_feedback, answer_feedback, opinion_feedback, remarks, descriptions, environment, create_time, update_time FROM ai_history_message WHERE (question_feedback is not null AND question_feedback != '') OR (answer_feedback is not null AND answer_feedback != '') OR (opinion_feedback is not null AND opinion_feedback != '') AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = #{vo.times} order by create_time

SELECT id, user_name as userName, conversation_id as conversationId, session_uuid as sessionUuid, question, answer, answer_time as answerTime, is_good as isGood, question_feedback as questionFeedback, answer_feedback as answerFeedback, opinion_feedback as opinionFeedback, create_time as createTime FROM ai_history_message where DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = #{vo.times} order by create_time

SELECT id, user_id, user_name, conversation_id, agent_id, agent_name, fenci_session_id, fenci_agent_id, fenci_agent_name, question, actual_question, split_words, answer, answer_all, permission, is_deep, is_good, answer_time,session_uuid, question_feedback, answer_feedback, opinion_feedback, remarks, descriptions, environment, create_time, update_time FROM ai_history_message where user_id = #{vo.userId} and session_uuid = #{vo.sessionUuid} ORDER BY create_time

SELECT TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX( REPLACE(a.split_words, '，', ','), ',', n.n ), ',', -1)) AS word, COUNT(*) AS counts FROM ai_history_message a JOIN ( SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 ) n ON n.n <= LENGTH(REPLACE(a.split_words, '，', ',')) - LENGTH(REPLACE(REPLACE(a.split_words, '，', ','), ',', '')) + 1 WHERE a.split_words IS NOT NULL AND a.split_words != '' AND TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX( REPLACE(a.split_words, '，', ','), ',', n.n ), ',', -1)) NOT REGEXP '[0-9]{4}年|[0-9]{1,2}月|[0-9]{1,2}日|年|月|日' GROUP BY word ORDER BY counts DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT t1.question, t1.split_words as word , sum(t2.counts) as counts FROM ai_history_message t1 JOIN ( SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(split_words, '，', ','), ' ,', ','), ', ', ',') AS norm_words, MAX(update_time) AS max_time, COUNT(*) AS counts FROM ai_history_message WHERE split_words IS NOT NULL AND split_words != '' GROUP BY norm_words ) t2 ON REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t1.split_words, '，', ','), ' ,', ','), ', ', ',') = t2.norm_words AND t1.update_time = t2.max_time group by t1.question ORDER BY t2.counts DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT t1.question, t1.split_words as word , sum(t2.counts) as counts FROM ai_history_message t1 JOIN ( SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(split_words, '，', ','), ' ,', ','), ', ', ',') AS norm_words, MAX(update_time) AS max_time, COUNT(*) AS counts FROM ai_history_message WHERE split_words IS NOT NULL AND split_words != '' GROUP BY norm_words ) t2 ON REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(t1.split_words, '，', ','), ' ,', ','), ', ', ',') = t2.norm_words AND t1.update_time = t2.max_time WHERE t1.question like concat('%', #{question}, '%') GROUP by t1.question ORDER BY t2.counts DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT id, user_id, user_name, question, answer, answer_time,create_time, update_time FROM ai_history_message WHERE create_time > #{startTime} and create_time < #{endTime} ORDER BY create_time

SELECT id, user_id, user_name, conversation_id, agent_id, agent_name, fenci_session_id, fenci_agent_id, question, actual_question, split_words, permission, is_deep, is_good, answer_time,session_uuid, question_feedback, answer_feedback, opinion_feedback, environment, create_time, update_time FROM ai_history_message where split_words is null or split_words = '' ORDER BY create_time
